environment.description: Production analytics service deployed on EKS cluster (us-east-1). Spring Boot 2.7.x running on Tomcat 9.0.62. LaunchDarkly SDK initialized with SDK key 'sdk-prod-analytics-7f2a'. The feature flag 'analytics.legacy-redirect-mode' is currently enabled (targeting rule: environment='production', variation=true) to support legacy mobile SDK clients during migration period ending Q3 2024. No reverse proxy header sanitization configured. Service is directly exposed via AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) on port 8080.
